story: Use a short narrative with an opening, development, and ending.
character_design: Use a character profile with appearance, traits, and narrative role. Leave unsupported details unspecified.
game_design: Use a design brief with premise, setting, and player experience. Leave unsupported details unspecified.
lyrics: Use labeled Verse and Chorus sections and a recurring refrain.
magazine: Use a magazine feature with a headline, opening paragraph, and short body.
derivative_work: Use a reinterpretation with a title, short adaptation note, and adapted passage.
poem: Use a title and a poetic composition arranged in stanzas.
motivational_speech: Use a speech with an opening address, central reflection, and closing line.
podcast_script: Use host dialogue and narration, with a short opening and sign-off.
movie_script: Use a scene heading, scene description, and dialogue where supported.
theater_dialogue: Use stage directions and named lines of stage dialogue where supported.
rap: Use rhythmic verses, line breaks, and a recurring hook.
tv_series_script: Use an episode excerpt with scene headings, action lines, and dialogue where supported.
